title: verbena litoralis var. subglabrata
intro: Verbena litoralis var. subglabrata, commonly known as Beach Verbena, is a plant species belonging to the Verbenaceae family, characterized by its small white or pinkish flowers and fragrant leaves. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and stress due to its calming effects. The health benefits of Beach Verbena include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include essential oils like linalool, limonene, and geraniol, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which work together to provide its medicinal benefits.
